abstract: Germ cell tumors predominantly involve the gonads but may rarely be found outside of the gonads, primarily in midline structures. We describe the case of a 27-year-old male with an asymptomatic 8 cm teratoma located within the lesser sac of his omentum. This is the fourth case of a teratoma located within the lesser sac of the omentum, which provides the opportunity to make some comparisons. Finally, we discuss some of the etiologic theories behind extragonadal germ cell tumors and how they relate to teratomas in the lesser sac.
abstract_ja: 胚細胞腫瘍は主に性腺に発生するが、まれに性腺外、主に正中構造に発生することがある。本論文では27歳男性の、無症状の8cm奇形腫が大網の網嚢内に存在した症例を報告する。網嚢内奇形腫の4例目であり、比較検討を可能にする。性腺外胚細胞腫瘍の病因論と、網嚢奇形腫との関連についても考察する。
